slides.title:
Hungry
on a cut?
slides.sub:
Starving by 4 pm, every day?
It's usually not willpower.
It's these 4 things.

slides.name: Too little protein
slides.cue: Protein keeps you full longer than carbs or fat. Put a protein source in every meal.

slides.name: Low-volume food
slides.cue: Same calories, 4× the food. Pick foods with lots of water and fibre: fruit, veg, potatoes, soups.

slides.name: Drinking your calories
slides.cue: Drinks don't fill you up like food does. Swap to water, zero drinks or black coffee.

slides.name: Short sleep
slides.cue: In a sleep-lab study, 2 nights of 4 h sleep raised hunger by about a quarter. Sleep is part of your diet.
